supplementary_component_briefs.purpose: Detailed component contracts for new support components whose wireframe elements provide structural placement but require richer specification for implementation.

brief.description: Reusable kanban column container that renders a stage header with count, accepts card drops, and renders child Placard cards. Parameterized by stage — not a separate component per column.

prop.name: stage
prop.description: One of: applied, interviewing, offered, rejected, archived

prop.name: label
prop.description: Display label for column header (i18n key resolved by caller)

prop.name: count
prop.description: Number of applications in this stage

prop.name: applications
prop.description: Filtered list of applications for this stage

prop.name: onDrop
prop.description: Callback when a card is dropped into this column

prop.name: onCardClick
prop.description: Callback when a card in this column is clicked

prop.name: variant
prop.description: Visual variant — archived columns may render collapsed by default

state.name: isDragOver
state.description: Whether a card is currently hovering over this column

state.name: isCollapsed
state.description: For archived variant: whether column is collapsed

event.name: onDrop
event.handler: Extract applicationId from dataTransfer, call props.onDrop(applicationId, stage)

render_contract.section: Column label + count badge. Uses --sys-type-font-work-sans heading.
Vertical stack of Placard components with 8px gap. Scrollable overflow.
Full column area is a valid drop target. isDragOver state adds inkGold border highlight via spring animation.

test.description: Renders column header with label and count
Renders Placard cards for each application in the stage
Calls onDrop with correct applicationId and targetStage on drop event
Calls onCardClick with applicationId on card click
Shows inkGold highlight during drag-over
Archived variant renders collapsed by default with expand toggle

story.name: Default
story.args: stage=applied, label='Applied', count=3, applications=[...3 mock apps]

brief.description: Modal panel displaying full application details. Uses Megaphone archetype. Contains tabbed content (timeline, notes, details), hosts ApplicationEditForm, ApplicationStatusActions, and ApplicationArchiveAction as children.

prop.name: applicationId
prop.description: ID of the application to display

prop.name: isOpen
prop.description: Whether the modal is visible

prop.name: onClose
prop.description: Close the modal

prop.name: onStatusChange
prop.description: Callback when status changes, propagated from ApplicationStatusActions

prop.name: onArchive
prop.description: Callback when application is archived

state.name: activeTab
state.description: Currently selected tab in the detail view

event.name: onClose
event.source: Escape key, backdrop click, close button

event.name: onEditSave
event.handler: Invalidate applicationDetail query to refresh data

render_contract.section: Application title (job_title at company), close button. Megaphone shape.

section.name: content_left
section.subsection: Chronological list of events (applied, emails, interviews, offers)
Read-only job description, salary range, company info

accessibility.rule: Modal must trap focus when open (aria-modal=true)
Escape key must close the modal
Tab bar must be keyboard-navigable with arrow keys
Close button must have aria-label="Close application details"

test.description: Renders when isOpen=true, hidden when false
Fetches application detail on open
Shows loading skeleton while fetching
Shows error state when fetch fails
Tab switching displays correct content panel
Escape key calls onClose
Backdrop click calls onClose
Renders ApplicationEditForm in notes tab
Renders ApplicationStatusActions in right pane
Renders ApplicationArchiveAction at bottom right
Focus trapped within modal

brief.description: Form for editing application metadata: notes, salary offered, contact name, next steps. Uses Scaffold archetype for input fields. Embedded within ApplicationDetailPanel.

prop.name: applicationId
prop.description: ID of the application to edit

prop.name: initialData
prop.description: Pre-populated form data from parent query

prop.name: onSave
prop.description: Callback with form data on successful save

mutation.name: updateApplication
mutation.on_success: Call props.onSave, set isDirty=false, show save confirmation

event.name: onCancel
event.handler: Reset formState to initialData, set isDirty=false

token.usage: Form container and input field shapes

test.description: Renders all form fields with labels
Pre-populates from initialData when provided
Sets isDirty=true on field change
Validates required fields on submit
Shows field-level validation errors
Calls onSave after successful mutation
Shows inline save confirmation on success
Cancel resets form to initialData
Disables submit button while mutation is in flight

story.name: Empty
story.description: No initial data, all fields blank

story.name: Prepopulated
story.args: applicationId='app-1', initialData={notes:'Strong fit', salary_offered:'$120k', contact_name:'Jane', next_steps:'Send portfolio'}

story.name: Dirty
story.description: Form with unsaved changes, save button enabled

brief.description: Toolbar of status transition actions rendered in the detail modal right pane. Uses Strike archetype buttons. Actions are contextual based on current application status — only valid transitions are shown.

prop.name: applicationId
prop.description: ID of the application

prop.name: currentStatus
prop.description: Current stage of the application

prop.name: onStatusChange
prop.description: Callback after successful status transition

state.name: confirmingAction
state.description: Which action is awaiting user confirmation

accessibility.rule: Toolbar must use role="toolbar" with aria-label
Buttons must be keyboard-navigable with arrow keys within toolbar
Confirmation dialog must trap focus and announce action
Disabled buttons (invalid transitions) must have aria-disabled=true

test.description: Only renders actions valid for currentStatus
Shows confirmation step before executing status change
Shows loading state on button during mutation
Calls onStatusChange after successful mutation
Shows inline error on mutation failure
Cancel confirmation resets to default state
Keyboard navigation between action buttons works

story.name: StatusApplied
story.description: Shows valid transitions from applied stage

brief.description: Single-purpose button for archiving or restoring an application. Uses Strike archetype with destructive variant. Rendered at the bottom of ApplicationDetailPanel right pane.

prop.name: applicationId
prop.description: ID of the application

prop.name: isArchived
prop.description: Whether the application is currently archived (determines button label and action)

prop.name: onArchive
prop.description: Callback after successful archive

prop.name: onRestore
prop.description: Callback after successful restore

event.name: onConfirm
event.handler: Trigger archive or restore mutation based on isArchived prop

test.description: Shows 'Archive Application' when isArchived=false
Shows 'Restore Application' when isArchived=true
Shows confirmation step before executing
Calls onArchive after successful archive mutation
Calls onRestore after successful restore mutation
Shows loading state during mutation
Shows error state on mutation failure
